name: Engine hoist / crane (2-ton min, foldable)
purpose: Lifting engine out of bay for removal and installation
notes: General hardware/builders-merchant stores (ambod.fo, Bygma Balslev-type) typically don't stock engine hoists — check a dedicated automotive tool supplier, plant-hire/rental counter, or order online. Foldable type recommended for garage storage.

name: Engine leveler / load balancer
purpose: Controlling engine angle during removal/install through tight E70 engine bay
notes: Same sourcing note as the hoist — a specialty automotive tool supplier or rental counter, not general hardware stock.

name: Torque wrench, click-type (low range, 5–60 Nm)
purpose: Precision torque on small fasteners: sensors, injector clamps, banjo bolts
notes: Standard stock item at general hardware stores — look for Bahco, Force, or Bosch branded kits.

name: Torque wrench, click-type (high range, 40–250 Nm)
purpose: Main bearings, head bolts (initial stage), suspension, wheel bolts
notes: Standard stock item at general hardware stores — Bahco, Force, and Hazet ranges commonly carried at this price point.

name: Torque angle gauge
purpose: Torque-to-yield fastener angle stages (head bolts, main/rod caps, subframe)
notes: Safety-critical for engine internals — a simple dial/protractor type is usually stocked alongside torque wrenches at general hardware stores.

name: Socket set, Torx + hex + 12-point (metric)
purpose: BMW-specific fastener types throughout engine bay
notes: Core hardware-store stock — Bahco, Force, or Facom sets in this range typically cover the full Torx/hex/12-point spread this engine needs.

name: Long extension bar set
purpose: Reaching rear-of-engine and bellhousing fasteners
notes: Standard hardware-store stock, usually sold alongside socket sets.

name: Fuel line disconnect tool set
purpose: Disconnecting high pressure diesel fuel lines without damage
notes: More of an automotive-specialty item — a general hardware store is less likely to stock BMW-specific quick-connect sizes; check an automotive tool supplier or order online.

name: Coolant pressure test / refill kit
purpose: Bleeding cooling system and leak testing after reassembly
notes: Sometimes stocked at larger general hardware stores in the automotive/workshop aisle; otherwise an automotive tool supplier.

name: Fluid evacuator / drain pump
purpose: Draining oil, coolant, transmission fluid cleanly
notes: Common general hardware-store stock in the automotive/workshop section.

name: OBD / BMW diagnostic interface (ENET or K+DCAN)
purpose: Fault code reading, injector coding, battery registration via ISTA/E-Sys
notes: Not general hardware-store stock — this is a BMW-specific diagnostic cable, typically bought online from a specialist supplier. ENET cable + laptop with ISTA-D/ISTA-P recommended for E70.

name: Compression / leak-down tester (diesel)
purpose: Verifying replacement engine cylinder health before install
notes: Automotive-specialty tool — check an auto parts/tool supplier rather than a general hardware store; diesel glow-plug-thread adapters in particular are a niche item.

name: Crank pulley holding tool
purpose: Holding crankshaft while breaking vibration damper bolt torque
notes: BMW-specific tool, unlikely to be general hardware-store stock — check an automotive tool supplier or a BMW specialist workshop for rental/loan.

name: Spring compressor set
purpose: Front strut service during suspension refresh
notes: Common general hardware-store stock. Only needed if non-adaptive coil suspension is fitted.

name: Ball joint separator / pickle fork
purpose: Suspension component separation
notes: Common general hardware-store stock, automotive/workshop aisle.

name: Digital multimeter
purpose: Wiring diagnostics, ground continuity checks, sensor testing
notes: Core general hardware-store stock — a mid-range auto-rated multimeter (Fluke-adjacent or a hardware-store house brand) is plenty for this project.

name: Wire labeling supplies (heat-shrink tags, printer)
purpose: Physical connector ID labels matching Wire Labeling System entries
notes: General hardware/electrical-supplies stock — heat-shrink tags and a basic label printer (Brady-adjacent or a hardware-store house brand) are commonly carried.

name: Engine stand
purpose: Supporting removed engine for teardown/inspection off the hoist
notes: Less common general hardware-store stock — check a workshop/automotive tool supplier, or a plant-hire counter for a short-term rental.

name: Parts organizer bins + zip bags
purpose: Sorting bolts/fasteners by removal stage to prevent mix-ups
notes: Core general hardware/builders-merchant stock — small parts bin racks and fastener organizers are a staple aisle at stores like this.

name: Shop press
purpose: Bushing and bearing service on suspension components
notes: Larger general hardware stores sometimes carry a benchtop shop press; otherwise a workshop/automotive tool supplier.

name: Trim removal tool set
purpose: Interior panel removal without damaging clips for restoration work
notes: Inexpensive, commonly stocked general hardware-store item.

name: LED work light / garage lighting rig
purpose: General visibility for detail work and photo documentation
notes: Core general hardware/builders-merchant stock — rechargeable LED work-light rigs are a staple at stores like ambod.fo and Bygma/Balslev.

name: Impact wrench (electric or air, 1/2" drive)
purpose: Fast removal of already-loosened fasteners (never for final torque on safety-critical bolts)
notes: Core general hardware-store stock — Bosch, Makita, or Milwaukee cordless impact wrenches are widely carried. Loosening only — always finish safety-critical fasteners with a click-type torque wrench.

name: Battery-powered angle grinder + cut-off wheels
purpose: Cutting seized fasteners, trimming brackets, general fabrication
notes: Core general hardware-store stock, typically Bosch/Makita/Milwaukee cordless ranges.

name: Wire brush set + degreaser + pressure washer access
purpose: Engine bay cleaning and rust treatment before replacement engine install
notes: Core general hardware/builders-merchant stock — degreaser, wire brushes, and rust converter are a standard aisle.
